'''
filter.py - Remove JavaScript from an HTML file to prevent XSS attacks.

Usage:
 python3 filter.py <html_file>

The file is modified in place. Legitimate HTML structure, formatting, tables,
headers and non-dangerous attributes are preserved byte-for-byte; only

import sys
import re
from html import unescape


# ===========================================================================
# Script element removal
# ===========================================================================
# Self-closing script tags: <script/>, <script />, <script src='x' />
# Processed FIRST so they are not mistaken for block-opening tags.
SCRIPT_SELF_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*/\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Paired script blocks: <script ...> ... </script>
SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
# Unclosed script start tags (no matching </script> anywhere after them).
# Remove just the tag; the orphaned content becomes inert visible text.
SCRIPT_OPEN_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Event handler attributes: on*='...' / on*='...' / on*=unquoted
# ===========================================================================
ON_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+on[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# URL-bearing attributes that may carry a javascript: pseudo-URL
# ===========================================================================
_URL_ATTRS = (
 'href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href|background|poster|data|dynsrc|'
 'lowsrc|codebase|classid|archive|manifest|longdesc|usemap|cite|profile'
)
URL_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'(?P<prefix>\s+(?:' + _URL_ATTRS + r')\s*=\s*)'
 r'(?P<value>\'[^\']*\'|'[^']*'|[^\s\''<>]+)',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# iframe srcdoc (inline HTML document - always removed)
# ===========================================================================
SRCDOC_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+srcdoc\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,

 r'''\s+style\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',

)
META_CONTENT_RE = re.compile(
 r'''content\s*=\s*(?:'([^']*)'|'([^']*)'|([^\s''/>]+))''', re.IGNORECASE
)

# ===========================================================================

 'javascript:',
 'vbscript:',
 'livescript:',
 'mocha:',
 'jscript:',
)
_DANGEROUS_DATA = (
 'data:text/html',
 'data:image/svg+xml',
 'data:application/xhtml+xml',
 'data:application/xml',
 'data:text/xml',
)

 for prefix in _DANGEROUS_DATA:
 if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
 return True
 return False


# ===========================================================================
# Substitution helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _url_attr_sub(match):
 value = match.group('value')

 inner = value[1:-1]
 else:
 inner = value
 if is_dangerous_url(inner):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


def _meta_sub(match):

 if not META_REFRESH_RE.search(tag):

 cm = META_CONTENT_RE.search(tag)
 if not cm:
 return tag

 # This prevents them from being treated as block openers.

 html = SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE.sub('', html)
 # 3. Remove any remaining unclosed script start tags (just the tag).
 html = SCRIPT_OPEN_RE.sub('', html)
 # 4. Remove event-handler attributes.
 html = ON_ATTR_RE.sub('', html)
 # 5. Remove iframe srcdoc.
 html = SRCDOC_RE.sub('', html)
 # 6. Remove dangerous style attributes (CSS JS vectors).
 html = STYLE_ATTR_RE.sub(_style_sub, html)
 # 7. Neutralise dangerous URL attributes.
 html = URL_ATTR_RE.sub(_url_attr_sub, html)
 # 8. Remove dangerous <meta http-equiv='refresh'>.
 html = META_TAG_RE.sub(_meta_sub, html)

 fh.write(cleaned.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape'))
 return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
 sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
'''
filter.py - Remove JavaScript from an HTML file to prevent XSS attacks.

Usage:
 python3 filter.py <html_file>

The file is modified in place. Legitimate HTML structure, formatting, tables,
headers and non-dangerous attributes are preserved byte-for-byte; only
JavaScript-bearing constructs are removed.
'''

import sys
import re
from html import unescape


# ===========================================================================
# Script element removal
# ===========================================================================
# Self-closing script tags: <script/>, <script />, <script src='x' />
# Processed FIRST so they are not mistaken for block-opening tags.
SCRIPT_SELF_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*/\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Paired script blocks: <script ...> ... </script>
SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
# Unclosed script start tags (no matching </script> anywhere after them).
# Remove just the tag; the orphaned content becomes inert visible text.
SCRIPT_OPEN_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Event handler attributes: on*='...' / on*='...' / on*=unquoted
# ===========================================================================
ON_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+on[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# URL-bearing attributes that may carry a javascript: pseudo-URL
# ===========================================================================
_URL_ATTRS = (
 'href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href|background|poster|data|dynsrc|'
 'lowsrc|codebase|classid|archive|manifest|longdesc|usemap|cite|profile'
)
URL_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'(?P<prefix>\s+(?:' + _URL_ATTRS + r')\s*=\s*)'
 r'(?P<value>\'[^\']*\'|'[^']*'|[^\s\''<>]+)',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# iframe srcdoc (inline HTML document - always removed)
# ===========================================================================
SRCDOC_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+srcdoc\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Dangerous style attributes (CSS-based JavaScript vectors)
# ===========================================================================
STYLE_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+style\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _style_is_dangerous(match):
 '''Return True if a style attribute contains CSS-based JS vectors.'''
 value = match.group(0)
 # Extract the quoted value
 m = re.search(r'=[\s]*(['\'])(.*?)\1', value)
 if m:
 inner = m.group(2)
 else:
 # Unquoted
 m2 = re.search(r'=[\s]*([^\s'\'<>]+)', value)
 inner = m2.group(1) if m2 else ''
 decoded = unescape(inner).lower()
 # Remove control chars and whitespace for obfuscation detection
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return (
 'javascript:' in cleaned
 or 'expression(' in cleaned
 or '-moz-binding' in cleaned
 or 'vbscript:' in cleaned
 )


def _style_sub(match):
 if _style_is_dangerous(match):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


# ===========================================================================
# <meta http-equiv='refresh' content='...;url=javascript:...'>
# ===========================================================================
META_TAG_RE = re.compile(r'<meta\b[^>]*>', re.IGNORECASE)
META_REFRESH_RE = re.compile(
 r'http-equiv\s*=\s*[\'']?refresh[\'']?', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_CONTENT_RE = re.compile(
 r'''content\s*=\s*(?:'([^']*)'|'([^']*)'|([^\s''/>]+))''', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_URL_RE = re.compile(r'''url\s*=\s*([^\s;''<>]+)''', re.IGNORECASE)


# ===========================================================================
# URL scheme / danger detection
# ===========================================================================
_DANGEROUS_SCHEMES = (
 'javascript:',
 'vbscript:',
 'livescript:',
 'mocha:',
 'jscript:',
)
_DANGEROUS_DATA = (
 'data:text/html',
 'data:image/svg+xml',
 'data:application/xhtml+xml',
 'data:application/xml',
 'data:text/xml',
)


def _normalise_url(value):
 '''Decode entities and strip control chars / whitespace used to obfuscate
 the scheme, so that e.g. jav
ascript: is detected.'''
 decoded = unescape(value)
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return cleaned.lower()


def is_dangerous_url(value):
 cleaned = _normalise_url(value)
 for scheme in _DANGEROUS_SCHEMES:
 if cleaned.startswith(scheme):
 return True
 for prefix in _DANGEROUS_DATA:
 if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
 return True
 return False


# ===========================================================================
# Substitution helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _url_attr_sub(match):
 value = match.group('value')
 if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in '\''':
 inner = value[1:-1]
 else:
 inner = value
 if is_dangerous_url(inner):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


def _meta_sub(match):
 tag = match.group(0)
 if not META_REFRESH_RE.search(tag):
 return tag
 cm = META_CONTENT_RE.search(tag)
 if not cm:
 return tag
 content = cm.group(1) or cm.group(2) or cm.group(3) or ''
 um = META_URL_RE.search(unescape(content))
 if um and is_dangerous_url(um.group(1)):
 return ''
 return tag


# ===========================================================================
# Main filter
# ===========================================================================
def filter_html(html):
 # 1. Remove self-closing script tags FIRST (just the tag itself).
 # This prevents them from being treated as block openers.
 html = SCRIPT_SELF_RE.sub('', html)
 # 2. Remove paired script blocks (entire element including content).
 html = SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE.sub('', html)
 # 3. Remove any remaining unclosed script start tags (just the tag).
 html = SCRIPT_OPEN_RE.sub('', html)
 # 4. Remove event-handler attributes.
 html = ON_ATTR_RE.sub('', html)
 # 5. Remove iframe srcdoc.
 html = SRCDOC_RE.sub('', html)
 # 6. Remove dangerous style attributes (CSS JS vectors).
 html = STYLE_ATTR_RE.sub(_style_sub, html)
 # 7. Neutralise dangerous URL attributes.
 html = URL_ATTR_RE.sub(_url_attr_sub, html)
 # 8. Remove dangerous <meta http-equiv='refresh'>.
 html = META_TAG_RE.sub(_meta_sub, html)
 return html


def main(argv):
 if len(argv) < 2:
 sys.stderr.write('Usage: python3 filter.py <html_file>\n')
 return 1
 path = argv[1]
 with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
 raw = fh.read()
 text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')
 cleaned = filter_html(text)
 with open(path, 'wb') as fh:
 fh.write(cleaned.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape'))
 return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
 sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
'''
filter.py - Remove JavaScript from an HTML file to prevent XSS attacks.

Usage:
 python3 filter.py <html_file>

The file is modified in place. Legitimate HTML structure, formatting, tables,
headers and non-dangerous attributes are preserved byte-for-byte; only
JavaScript-bearing constructs are removed.

import sys
import re
from html import unescape


# ===========================================================================
# Script element removal
# ===========================================================================
# Self-closing script tags: <script/>, <script />, <script src='x' />
# Processed FIRST so they are not mistaken for block-opening tags.
SCRIPT_SELF_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*/\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Paired script blocks: <script ...> ... </script>
SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
# Unclosed script start tags (no matching </script> anywhere after them).
# Remove just the tag; the orphaned content becomes inert visible text.
SCRIPT_OPEN_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Event handler attributes: on*='...' / on*='...' / on*=unquoted
# ===========================================================================
ON_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+on[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# URL-bearing attributes that may carry a javascript: pseudo-URL
# ===========================================================================
_URL_ATTRS = (
 'href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href|background|poster|data|dynsrc|'
 'lowsrc|codebase|classid|archive|manifest|longdesc|usemap|cite|profile'
)
URL_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'(?P<prefix>\s+(?:' + _URL_ATTRS + r')\s*=\s*)'
 r'(?P<value>\'[^\']*\'|'[^']*'|[^\s\''<>]+)',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# iframe srcdoc (inline HTML document - always removed)
# ===========================================================================
SRCDOC_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+srcdoc\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Dangerous style attributes (CSS-based JavaScript vectors)
# ===========================================================================
STYLE_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+style\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _style_is_dangerous(match):
 '''Return True if a style attribute contains CSS-based JS vectors.'''
 value = match.group(0)
 # Extract the quoted value
 m = re.search(r'=[\s]*(['\'])(.*?)\1', value)
 if m:
 inner = m.group(2)
 else:
 # Unquoted
 m2 = re.search(r'=[\s]*([^\s'\'<>]+)', value)
 inner = m2.group(1) if m2 else ''
 decoded = unescape(inner).lower()
 # Remove control chars and whitespace for obfuscation detection
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return (
 'javascript:' in cleaned
 or 'expression(' in cleaned
 or '-moz-binding' in cleaned
 or 'vbscript:' in cleaned
 )


def _style_sub(match):
 if _style_is_dangerous(match):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


# ===========================================================================
# <meta http-equiv='refresh' content='...;url=javascript:...'>
# ===========================================================================
META_TAG_RE = re.compile(r'<meta\b[^>]*>', re.IGNORECASE)
META_REFRESH_RE = re.compile(
 r'http-equiv\s*=\s*[\'']?refresh[\'']?', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_CONTENT_RE = re.compile(
 r'''content\s*=\s*(?:'([^']*)'|'([^']*)'|([^\s''/>]+))''', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_URL_RE = re.compile(r'''url\s*=\s*([^\s;''<>]+)''', re.IGNORECASE)

# URL scheme / danger detection
# ===========================================================================
_DANGEROUS_SCHEMES = (
 'javascript:',
 'vbscript:',
 'livescript:',
 'mocha:',
 'jscript:',
)
_DANGEROUS_DATA = (
 'data:text/html',
 'data:image/svg+xml',
 'data:application/xhtml+xml',
 'data:application/xml',
 'data:text/xml',
)


def _normalise_url(value):
 '''Decode entities and strip control chars / whitespace used to obfuscate
 the scheme, so that e.g. jav
ascript: is detected.'''
 decoded = unescape(value)
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return cleaned.lower()


def is_dangerous_url(value):
 cleaned = _normalise_url(value)
 for scheme in _DANGEROUS_SCHEMES:
 if cleaned.startswith(scheme):
 return True
 for prefix in _DANGEROUS_DATA:
 if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
 return True
 return False


# ===========================================================================
# Substitution helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _url_attr_sub(match):
 value = match.group('value')
 if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in '\''':
 inner = value[1:-1]
 else:
 inner = value
 if is_dangerous_url(inner):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


def _meta_sub(match):
 tag = match.group(0)
 if not META_REFRESH_RE.search(tag):
 return tag
 cm = META_CONTENT_RE.search(tag)
 if not cm:
 return tag
 content = cm.group(1) or cm.group(2) or cm.group(3) or ''
 um = META_URL_RE.search(unescape(content))
 if um and is_dangerous_url(um.group(1)):
 return ''
 return tag

# Main filter
# ===========================================================================
def filter_html(html):
 # 1. Remove self-closing script tags FIRST (just the tag itself).
 # This prevents them from being treated as block openers.
 html = SCRIPT_SELF_RE.sub('', html)
 # 2. Remove paired script blocks (entire element including content).
 html = SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE.sub('', html)
 # 3. Remove any remaining unclosed script start tags (just the tag).
 html = SCRIPT_OPEN_RE.sub('', html)
 # 4. Remove event-handler attributes.
 html = ON_ATTR_RE.sub('', html)
 # 5. Remove iframe srcdoc.
 html = SRCDOC_RE.sub('', html)
 # 6. Remove dangerous style attributes (CSS JS vectors).
 html = STYLE_ATTR_RE.sub(_style_sub, html)
 # 7. Neutralise dangerous URL attributes.
 html = URL_ATTR_RE.sub(_url_attr_sub, html)
 # 8. Remove dangerous <meta http-equiv='refresh'>.
 html = META_TAG_RE.sub(_meta_sub, html)
 return html


def main(argv):
 if len(argv) < 2:
 sys.stderr.write('Usage: python3 filter.py <html_file>\n')
 return 1
 path = argv[1]

 raw = fh.read()
 text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')
 cleaned = filter_html(text)
 with open(path, 'wb') as fh:
 fh.write(cleaned.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape'))
 return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
 sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

'''
filter.py - Remove JavaScript from an HTML file to prevent XSS attacks.

Usage:
 python3 filter.py <html_file>

The file is modified in place. Legitimate HTML structure, formatting, tables,
headers and non-dangerous attributes are preserved byte-for-byte; only

import re
from html import unescape

# Script element removal
# ===========================================================================

# Processed FIRST so they are not mistaken for block-opening tags.
SCRIPT_SELF_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*/\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Paired script blocks: <script ...> ... </script>
SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
# Unclosed script start tags (no matching </script> anywhere after them).
# Remove just the tag; the orphaned content becomes inert visible text.
SCRIPT_OPEN_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Event handler attributes: on*='...' / on*='...' / on*=unquoted
# ===========================================================================
ON_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+on[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# URL-bearing attributes that may carry a javascript: pseudo-URL
# ===========================================================================
_URL_ATTRS = (
 'href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href|background|poster|data|dynsrc|'
 'lowsrc|codebase|classid|archive|manifest|longdesc|usemap|cite|profile'
)
URL_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'(?P<prefix>\s+(?:' + _URL_ATTRS + r')\s*=\s*)'
 r'(?P<value>\'[^\']*\'|'[^']*'|[^\s\''<>]+)',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# iframe srcdoc (inline HTML document - always removed)
# ===========================================================================
SRCDOC_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+srcdoc\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)

# ===========================================================================

 r'''\s+style\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',

 value = match.group(0)

 if m:
 inner = m.group(2)

 inner = m2.group(1) if m2 else ''
 decoded = unescape(inner).lower()
 # Remove control chars and whitespace for obfuscation detection
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)

'''
filter.py - Remove JavaScript from an HTML file to prevent XSS attacks.

Usage:
 python3 filter.py <html_file>

The file is modified in place. Legitimate HTML structure, formatting, tables,
headers and non-dangerous attributes are preserved byte-for-byte; only
JavaScript-bearing constructs are removed.

import sys
import re
from html import unescape

# Script element removal
# ===========================================================================
# Self-closing script tags: <script/>, <script />, <script src='x' />
# Processed FIRST so they are not mistaken for block-opening tags.
SCRIPT_SELF_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*/\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Paired script blocks: <script ...> ... </script>
SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
# Unclosed script start tags (no matching </script> anywhere after them).
# Remove just the tag; the orphaned content becomes inert visible text.
SCRIPT_OPEN_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Event handler attributes: on*='...' / on*='...' / on*=unquoted
# ===========================================================================
ON_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+on[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# URL-bearing attributes that may carry a javascript: pseudo-URL
# ===========================================================================
_URL_ATTRS = (
 'href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href|background|poster|data|dynsrc|'
 'lowsrc|codebase|classid|archive|manifest|longdesc|usemap|cite|profile'
)
URL_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'(?P<prefix>\s+(?:' + _URL_ATTRS + r')\s*=\s*)'
 r'(?P<value>\'[^\']*\'|'[^']*'|[^\s\''<>]+)',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# iframe srcdoc (inline HTML document - always removed)
# ===========================================================================
SRCDOC_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+srcdoc\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Dangerous style attributes (CSS-based JavaScript vectors)
# ===========================================================================
STYLE_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+style\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _style_is_dangerous(match):
 '''Return True if a style attribute contains CSS-based JS vectors.'''
 value = match.group(0)
 # Extract the quoted value
 m = re.search(r'=[\s]*(['\'])(.*?)\1', value)
 if m:
 inner = m.group(2)
 else:
 # Unquoted
 m2 = re.search(r'=[\s]*([^\s'\'<>]+)', value)
 inner = m2.group(1) if m2 else ''
 decoded = unescape(inner).lower()

 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return (

 or '-moz-binding' in cleaned
 or 'vbscript:' in cleaned

def _style_sub(match):
 if _style_is_dangerous(match):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)

# ===========================================================================
META_TAG_RE = re.compile(r'<meta\b[^>]*>', re.IGNORECASE)
META_REFRESH_RE = re.compile(
 r'http-equiv\s*=\s*[\'']?refresh[\'']?', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_CONTENT_RE = re.compile(
 r'''content\s*=\s*(?:'([^']*)'|'([^']*)'|([^\s''/>]+))''', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_URL_RE = re.compile(r'''url\s*=\s*([^\s;''<>]+)''', re.IGNORECASE)


# ===========================================================================
# URL scheme / danger detection
# ===========================================================================
_DANGEROUS_SCHEMES = (
 'javascript:',
 'vbscript:',
 'livescript:',
 'mocha:',
 'jscript:',
)
_DANGEROUS_DATA = (
 'data:text/html',
 'data:image/svg+xml',
 'data:application/xhtml+xml',
 'data:application/xml',
 'data:text/xml',
)


def _normalise_url(value):

ascript: is detected.'''
 decoded = unescape(value)

 return cleaned.lower()

 cleaned = _normalise_url(value)
 for scheme in _DANGEROUS_SCHEMES:
 if cleaned.startswith(scheme):
 return True
 for prefix in _DANGEROUS_DATA:
 if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
 return True
 return False


# ===========================================================================
# Substitution helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _url_attr_sub(match):
 value = match.group('value')
 if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in '\''':
 inner = value[1:-1]
 else:
 inner = value
 if is_dangerous_url(inner):

def _meta_sub(match):

 if not META_REFRESH_RE.search(tag):

 if not cm:
 return tag

 if um and is_dangerous_url(um.group(1)):

 return tag

# Main filter
# ===========================================================================
def filter_html(html):
 # 1. Remove self-closing script tags FIRST (just the tag itself).
 # This prevents them from being treated as block openers.
 html = SCRIPT_SELF_RE.sub('', html)
 # 2. Remove paired script blocks (entire element including content).
 html = SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE.sub('', html)
 # 3. Remove any remaining unclosed script start tags (just the tag).
 html = SCRIPT_OPEN_RE.sub('', html)
 # 4. Remove event-handler attributes.
 html = ON_ATTR_RE.sub('', html)
 # 5. Remove iframe srcdoc.
 html = SRCDOC_RE.sub('', html)
 # 6. Remove dangerous style attributes (CSS JS vectors).
 html = STYLE_ATTR_RE.sub(_style_sub, html)
 # 7. Neutralise dangerous URL attributes.
 html = URL_ATTR_RE.sub(_url_attr_sub, html)
 # 8. Remove dangerous <meta http-equiv='refresh'>.
 html = META_TAG_RE.sub(_meta_sub, html)
 return html


def main(argv):
 if len(argv) < 2:
 sys.stderr.write('Usage: python3 filter.py <html_file>\n')
 return 1
 path = argv[1]
 with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
 raw = fh.read()
 text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')
 cleaned = filter_html(text)
 with open(path, 'wb') as fh:
 fh.write(cleaned.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape'))
 return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
 sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
'''
filter.py - Remove JavaScript from an HTML file to prevent XSS attacks.

Usage:
 python3 filter.py <html_file>

The file is modified in place. Legitimate HTML structure, formatting, tables,
headers and non-dangerous attributes are preserved byte-for-byte; only
JavaScript-bearing constructs are removed.
'''

import sys
import re
from html import unescape


# ===========================================================================
# Script element removal
# ===========================================================================
# Self-closing script tags: <script/>, <script />, <script src='x' />
# Processed FIRST so they are not mistaken for block-opening tags.
SCRIPT_SELF_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*/\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)
# Paired script blocks: <script ...> ... </script>
SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>.*?</script\s*>',
 re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
)
# Unclosed script start tags (no matching </script> anywhere after them).
# Remove just the tag; the orphaned content becomes inert visible text.
SCRIPT_OPEN_RE = re.compile(
 r'<script\b[^>]*>',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Event handler attributes: on*='...' / on*='...' / on*=unquoted
# ===========================================================================
ON_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+on[a-z][a-z0-9]*\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# URL-bearing attributes that may carry a javascript: pseudo-URL
# ===========================================================================
_URL_ATTRS = (
 'href|src|action|formaction|xlink:href|background|poster|data|dynsrc|'
 'lowsrc|codebase|classid|archive|manifest|longdesc|usemap|cite|profile'
)
URL_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'(?P<prefix>\s+(?:' + _URL_ATTRS + r')\s*=\s*)'
 r'(?P<value>\'[^\']*\'|'[^']*'|[^\s\''<>]+)',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# iframe srcdoc (inline HTML document - always removed)
# ===========================================================================
SRCDOC_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+srcdoc\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ===========================================================================
# Dangerous style attributes (CSS-based JavaScript vectors)
# ===========================================================================
STYLE_ATTR_RE = re.compile(
 r'''\s+style\s*=\s*(?:'[^']*'|'[^']*'|[^\s''<>]+)''',
 re.IGNORECASE,
)


def _style_is_dangerous(match):
 '''Return True if a style attribute contains CSS-based JS vectors.'''
 value = match.group(0)
 # Extract the quoted value
 m = re.search(r'=[\s]*(['\'])(.*?)\1', value)
 if m:
 inner = m.group(2)
 else:
 # Unquoted
 m2 = re.search(r'=[\s]*([^\s'\'<>]+)', value)
 inner = m2.group(1) if m2 else ''
 decoded = unescape(inner).lower()
 # Remove control chars and whitespace for obfuscation detection
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return (
 'javascript:' in cleaned
 or 'expression(' in cleaned
 or '-moz-binding' in cleaned
 or 'vbscript:' in cleaned
 )


def _style_sub(match):
 if _style_is_dangerous(match):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


# ===========================================================================
# <meta http-equiv='refresh' content='...;url=javascript:...'>
# ===========================================================================
META_TAG_RE = re.compile(r'<meta\b[^>]*>', re.IGNORECASE)
META_REFRESH_RE = re.compile(
 r'http-equiv\s*=\s*[\'']?refresh[\'']?', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_CONTENT_RE = re.compile(
 r'''content\s*=\s*(?:'([^']*)'|'([^']*)'|([^\s''/>]+))''', re.IGNORECASE
)
META_URL_RE = re.compile(r'''url\s*=\s*([^\s;''<>]+)''', re.IGNORECASE)


# ===========================================================================
# URL scheme / danger detection
# ===========================================================================
_DANGEROUS_SCHEMES = (
 'javascript:',
 'vbscript:',
 'livescript:',
 'mocha:',
 'jscript:',
)
_DANGEROUS_DATA = (
 'data:text/html',
 'data:image/svg+xml',
 'data:application/xhtml+xml',
 'data:application/xml',
 'data:text/xml',
)


def _normalise_url(value):
 '''Decode entities and strip control chars / whitespace used to obfuscate
 the scheme, so that e.g. jav
ascript: is detected.'''
 decoded = unescape(value)
 cleaned = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x20]+', '', decoded)
 return cleaned.lower()


def is_dangerous_url(value):
 cleaned = _normalise_url(value)
 for scheme in _DANGEROUS_SCHEMES:
 if cleaned.startswith(scheme):
 return True
 for prefix in _DANGEROUS_DATA:
 if cleaned.startswith(prefix):
 return True
 return False


# ===========================================================================
# Substitution helpers
# ===========================================================================
def _url_attr_sub(match):
 value = match.group('value')
 if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in '\''':
 inner = value[1:-1]
 else:
 inner = value
 if is_dangerous_url(inner):
 return ''
 return match.group(0)


def _meta_sub(match):
 tag = match.group(0)
 if not META_REFRESH_RE.search(tag):
 return tag
 cm = META_CONTENT_RE.search(tag)
 if not cm:
 return tag
 content = cm.group(1) or cm.group(2) or cm.group(3) or ''
 um = META_URL_RE.search(unescape(content))
 if um and is_dangerous_url(um.group(1)):
 return ''
 return tag


# ===========================================================================
# Main filter
# ===========================================================================
def filter_html(html):
 # 1. Remove self-closing script tags FIRST (just the tag itself).
 # This prevents them from being treated as block openers.
 html = SCRIPT_SELF_RE.sub('', html)
 # 2. Remove paired script blocks (entire element including content).
 html = SCRIPT_BLOCK_RE.sub('', html)
 # 3. Remove any remaining unclosed script start tags (just the tag).
 html = SCRIPT_OPEN_RE.sub('', html)
 # 4. Remove event-handler attributes.
 html = ON_ATTR_RE.sub('', html)
 # 5. Remove iframe srcdoc.
 html = SRCDOC_RE.sub('', html)
 # 6. Remove dangerous style attributes (CSS JS vectors).
 html = STYLE_ATTR_RE.sub(_style_sub, html)
 # 7. Neutralise dangerous URL attributes.
 html = URL_ATTR_RE.sub(_url_attr_sub, html)
 # 8. Remove dangerous <meta http-equiv='refresh'>.
 html = META_TAG_RE.sub(_meta_sub, html)
 return html


def main(argv):
 if len(argv) < 2:
 sys.stderr.write('Usage: python3 filter.py <html_file>\n')
 return 1
 path = argv[1]
 with open(path, 'rb') as fh:
 raw = fh.read()
 text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')
 cleaned = filter_html(text)
 with open(path, 'wb') as fh:
 fh.write(cleaned.encode('utf-8', errors='surrogateescape'))
 return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
 sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
